dpa.rule: Another attraction: earlier of purchase + 60 minutes and use-start time. Same attraction: after use or use-window end. Attractions and shows have separate eligibility.
dpa.releaseBoundary: The checked official pages provide no fixed all-attraction hourly replenishment schedule. Availability must be read from the app.

actions: Select restaurant, arrival time, menu items and quantities
Check details and payment method, then Place Order

diningDisplay.rule: Seating service venues are reservable; counter, required-mobile-order and snack venues share the no-seating-reservation group. Mobile ordering and marker type remain independent attributes.
